name: Spruce Beer
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: twice as much chippings of sassafras root
ingredients.originalText: twice as much chippings of sassafras root

instructions.text: Boil a handful of hops, and twice as much of the chippings of sassafras root, in ten gallons of water
Strain it, and pour in, while hot, one gallon of molasses, two spoonsful of the essence of spruce, two spoonsful of powdered ginger, and one of pounded allspice
When sufficiently cold, add half a pint of good yeast
Stir it well, stop it close, and when fermented and clear, bottle and cork it tight

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil a handful of hops, and twice as much of the chippings of sassafras root, in ten gallons of water
2. Strain it, and pour in, while hot, one gallon of molasses, two spoonsful of the essence of spruce, two spoonsful of powdered ginger, and one of pounded allspice
3. Put it in a cask
4. When sufficiently cold, add half a pint of good yeast
5. Stir it well, stop it close, and when fermented and clear, bottle and cork it tight
